purpose: Harmless real systemd execution-retention regression; no Aztec/native binary or financial action
status: Plan only, requires reviewed runner and separate serialized setup/execution grants

inventory.docker: Responsive desktop-linux, cgroupv2/cgroupfs/aarch64, zero running containers
inventory.images: Two existing pinned Aztec images retained; no cached official Ubuntu base. No verified systemd255 test image. Other image preserved.

fixedInputs.testCode: Fresh public-only helper and unit bytes to be source-reviewed/hash-pinned before execution; never entire repository context

setup.method: One owned setup container from digest; 180s/512MiB/2CPU/pids128. Default unprivileged Docker capabilities, no SYS_ADMIN for apt. Install only exact systemd/libsystemd-shared/libsystemd0/systemd-dev version from signed official Noble repositories with --no-install-recommends; policy-rc.d denies postinstall service activation. Package signature/index/hash verification stays enabled. Record resolved dependency versions and archive SHA256, systemctl/systemd binary hashes and final image ID. Fail if exact255 package unavailable; no arbitrary mirror/fallback.
setup.network: Only setup has network for official registry/Ubuntu packages. No developer environment, auth files, mounts, sockets, ports or private inputs passed.
setup.retention: Retain resulting public test image under exact digest for reviewed offline run, max1GiB incremental disk and100MiB package download budget. No prune/removal of existing images. Base download28,940,087B. Record actual bytes/disk; estimates are not measurements.

offlineTest.rootFilesystem: read-only; small tmpfs /run,/run/lock,/tmp,/var/log; prebuilt public units/helpers in image
offlineTest.namespaces: private cgroup,PID,IPC,mount; no host namespaces or host bind mounts

capabilities.proposal: Docker default capability set plus only SYS_ADMIN; explicitly drop NET_RAW and NET_BIND_SERVICE. No --privileged and no seccomp/AppArmor-unconfined override.
capabilities.justification: systemd PID1 needs to manage its container cgroup subtree; SYS_ADMIN permits remounting the existing private namespaced cgroup mount writable. Retain default credential/process/file capabilities used by manager. No cgroup host bind mount; no / or Mac directory access. SYS_ADMIN is broad in DockerVM and remains a material review item, not assumed harmless.
capabilities.preflight: Before systemd, verify cgroup namespace/root0::/, mount topology and512MiB/2CPU limits. Remount only already-present /sys/fs/cgroup in private namespace. If unavailable/denied or hierarchy not confined, fixed blocked receipt and stop; no privilege escalation/retry.

launchShape: docker create --pull=never --platform=linux/arm64 --network=none --cgroupns=private --read-only --memory=512m --memory-swap=512m --cpus=2 --pids-limit=128 --cap-add=SYS_ADMIN --cap-drop=NET_RAW --cap-drop=NET_BIND_SERVICE --security-opt=no-new-privileges --log-driver=none --stop-signal=SIGRTMIN+3 --stop-timeout=2 [bounded tmpfs] [exact derived image ID]
start only uniquely owned container after exclusive intent; host deadline starts before start; no --rm so State is captured before removal
assertions: Record actual systemd255 exact package/binary identity, fixed units and ordering dependency readbacks.
Baseline unreferenced true unit: start --wait then query; retain actual state, do not assume collection deterministically occurred. Baseline is diagnostic not a forced-failure gate.

Corrected fixedtimer Before=unit reference: timer remains active, worker is not automatically started, invoke once; --wait returns, actual state inactive/success/ExecMainCode1/ExecMainStatus0/startTimestamp>0. Query again after3s and require same execution identity.
Failed true/false and timeout/sleep fixtures must not become passing; exact existing classifier invoked from reviewed public subset where practical, no generated fake state.
No reverse cycle; timer deadline remains unchanged, only explicit once start, no Wants/Requires/restart. Stop harmless timer at cleanup, preserve unit exit records before removal.
offlineTest.cleanup: Host watchdog captures fixed container State exit/OOM/status and bounded public test receipt on all exits, stops/kills/removes only owned immutable container ID, confirms absence. Never deletes preexisting name/image; unknown create reconciles ID/name and never retries. No container processes remain. Preserve final image for provenance.

notYetBound: Signed package dependency closure/digests and derived image ID (setup output)
Whether DockerDesktop cgroupfs permits confined writable delegation with this minimal capability set; must fail closed if not.
claimsExcluded: No changes to existing Docker daemon settings/containers/images
No gate relaxation or promotion of Linux toolchain pin
